days.title: Coastal Viewpoints and Lower Access
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Carrigan Head
stops.detail: By car, one drives from Teelin, a small town southeast of the cliffs, via a 4.5 km long continuous two-lane road to Carrigan Head with a parking lot.

stops.name: Bunglass Point
stops.detail: Bunglass Point offers a view over the entire cliffs.

stops.name: Teelin
stops.detail: In summer, boat tours to the foot of the cliffs can be booked from Killybegs and Teelin.

days.title: Summit Hiking and Historic Ruins
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: One Man’s Pass
stops.detail: The One Man’s Pass, which is already signposted from Teelin, is part of a footpath over the ridge of the cliffs further to Malin Beg in the north.

stops.name: Pilgrim’s Pass
stops.detail: On foot, one can choose the Pilgrim’s Pass (also Old Man’s Pass) from An Charraig, which leads behind the cliffs to the chapel on the summit.

stops.name: An Charraig
stops.detail: The usual starting point for the path to Slieve League is the village of An Charraig (English: Carrick) northwest of Cill Charthaigh (English: Kilcar).

stops.name: Bienenkorbhütte
stops.detail: At the top of the cliff, protected by a semi-circular stone wall, there is a ruined beehive hut as well as the ruins of a chapel.
